# xlinux

> Build, install and debug iOS apps on a real iPhone from Linux, without a Mac. Flutter is supported today (release, debug with hot reload, native plugins via SwiftPM and CocoaPods-to-SwiftPM conversion); the core is framework-agnostic. Includes an MCP server so AI agents can see and drive the iPhone.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/cesardev31/xlinux/blob/main/README.md): how it works, installation, commands, limitations, credits
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/cesardev31/xlinux/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for AI agents using or modifying xlinux
- [Claude Code skill](https://github.com/cesardev31/xlinux/blob/main/skills/xlinux/SKILL.md): how an agent should run and drive apps with xlinux

## Commands

- `xlinux doctor`, `xlinux setup`
- `flutter run -d iphone-linux` (debug + hot reload)
- `xlinux build [--debug] [--install] [--project DIR]`, `xlinux run`
- `xlinux device screenshot|mirror|agent ...`
- `xlinux mcp`
